title: Parity-Aware Byte-Pair Encoding: Improving Cross-lingual Fairness in Tokenization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual tokenization disparities by measuring the Tokenizer Fairness Gini Coefficient, which quantifies inequalities in per-language compression rates and token costs on parallel corpora. The evaluation also includes intrinsic metrics like vocabulary utilization, fertility, and morphological alignment, as well as extrinsic downstream model performance across multiple languages.
